title: The nightly backup will stop fitting in its free store long before the gym database is full
what: Each night a full copy of the gym database is saved, and the last 7 copies are kept, in a free store that holds 1 GB in total. So once one copy passes about 140 MB, the night's save is refused and no new backup is made. The database itself may grow to 500 MB, so this happens at less than a third of the limit HQ watches. Nothing compares the copy size with the store's space, and the public backup check hides the size, so the first sign is a failed backup.
expected: HQ shows how full the backup store is and warns on Needs you well before 7 copies stop fitting, with a plan (fewer copies, packing, or a paid store) ready.
how_often: once the data grows to about 140 MB, then every night
fix_line: Track the copy size against the store space and warn at 60% and 80%; pack the copy or keep fewer copies before it is full

title: Anyone can make the pop-up sender run over and over, each time calling the gym server
what: The address that says "something was just sent, send pop-ups now" needs no sign-in. Its "once every 3 seconds" brake is kept only inside one running copy of the service, and the service runs many copies, so a script can start many runs a second. Each run asks the gym server for waiting pop-ups even when none wait, using free requests and server traffic that all gyms share.
expected: The early send is limited for the whole service (or needs a sign-in), so outsiders cannot burn the shared free allowances.
fix_line: Keep the 3-second brake in a shared place, or check that the caller is one of our own services

title: The English helper's monthly cost leaves out tries that Google still charges for
what: When a rewrite times out or comes back empty, the helper tries the next model, up to the most expensive one. Only the last, good answer is added to "this month's cost". The tries before it may still be billed by Google, and there is no monthly ceiling, so the cost shown can be lower than the bill.
expected: Every billed try is counted in the month's cost, and the helper stops or warns past a monthly amount.
how_often: when Google is slow or a model is retired
fix_line: Add the token use of every answered try to the month, and add a monthly cap with a Needs you line
